description:
Ask the Knowledge Stack agent a question and return the final answer.

Wraps the backend's two-step ask flow (POST user message → SSE stream)
into a single tool call: assembles the streamed text, captures any
inline citations, and returns once the agent emits ``message_end``.
Use this when you want one grounded answer rather than running your own
retrieval loop.

Citations are read from the persisted message once the stream closes,
so ``citations`` is populated even though the SSE protocol itself
carries only text.

Returns ``AskResult(answer, citations[], thread_id, message_id, ...)``.
Pass the same ``thread_id`` back on a follow-up call to continue the
conversation. For raw retrieval (without an LLM), use
``search_knowledge`` / ``search_hybrid`` + ``cite`` instead; for
schema-shaped output use ``extract``.

output_language.description: Language the answer is written in (`en` or `zh`). Omit to use the tenant's configured default.

question.description: Natural-language question to send to the KS agent.
question.title: Question

thread_id.description: Reuse an existing thread for multi-turn follow-ups. Omit to start a fresh thread, auto-titled from ``question``.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

timeout_s.description: Hard ceiling on the streaming wait. Beyond this we return whatever was assembled.
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

name: ask

AskCitation.description:
Citation attached to the assistant message produced by an ``ask`` call.

Lighter than ``Citation``: the thread stream carries text only, so these are
read from the persisted message's resolved citations after the stream closes.
No ``page_number`` — the backend does not resolve one on this path; use
``cite(chunk_id)`` when you need a page-aware footnote.

path_part_id.description: PDO id of the cited chunk — pass to `get_info` for ancestry.
path_part_id.title: Path Part Id

quote.description: The quoted text from the chunk.
quote.title: Quote

version_number.description: Document version the citation was resolved against.
version_number.title: Version Number

AskCitation.title: AskCitation

outputSchema.description: Final assistant answer assembled from a thread streaming run.

answer.description: The agent's final assistant message text.
answer.title: Answer

citations.description: Citations the agent emitted while answering. May be empty.
citations.title: Citations

is_error.description: True if the agent hit a terminal error mid-stream; ``answer`` then contains the error message.
is_error.title: Is Error

message_id.description: Assistant message id (use with `read_around`/`cite` if you need more context).
message_id.title: Message Id

thread_id.description: Thread the conversation lives on (reuse for follow-ups).
thread_id.title: Thread Id

workflow_id.description: Underlying agent workflow id; surfaced for debugging and audit.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

outputSchema.title: AskResult
